It says nothing about whether the issuer has usable fundamentals: 0 of 0 sectors have been measured, 20 XBRL tags are mapped and 8 items are derivable. An identity-resolved security is not a covered sector.

statusLine: 4 of 18 observed rows assessed · 9 unresolved · 6 holdings in scope · 1 out-of-scope security · 4 ineligible
notes: Resolution uses identity fields only (ISIN, exchange, symbol, series, CIN, company reference). Company names are never read by the resolver.
A resolved identity is not a valuation: IID-2 onwards would produce an assessment, and is not started.
Rows resolved through EXCHANGE_SYMBOL are labelled as such; a symbol is weaker evidence than an ISIN and is never presented as equivalent.
The roster in use is a synthetic fixture: the mechanics are verified, real-company identity coverage is not.
